# Introduction

This page uses a Tufte-style layout: a narrow main column for body text and a wide right margin for sidenotes, citations, and small figures.^[Footnotes render as sidenotes in the margin, right next to the text that references them.] Replace this text with your own.

Citations also appear in the margin [@tufte2001].

::: {.column-margin}
This is a margin note. Use a `.column-margin` div for any content — text, images, tables — that should sit beside the main column without a footnote number.
:::

# Sections

## Headings

Use first- and second-level headings to structure the page. They are listed in the table of contents on the left.

## Full-width content

Content can break out of the main column into the margin when it needs more room.

::: {.column-page-right}
This block spans the main column and the margin. Use it for wide figures, tables, or code.
:::

## Math

Inline math like $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$ and display math both work:

$$
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \sqrt{\pi}
$$
